This seems to say something about Khosrow and Shirin, a famous love story in Persian literature. It might mean: "To Khosrow, from Shirin, grants the desire - Gives the mountain-dweller remembrance from separation." It's about granting wishes or memories related to love and separation. The concept here is about the interplay of love, desire, and perhaps the pain of separation for some, while others achieve their goals.

This translates to: "One was created so ill-fated - One was created worthy of the throne." This is clearly about the arbitrariness of fate: some people are born unlucky, while others are born to greatness or royalty.

Option 3: "کسی را که بر تخت زر جای اوست - از آهن یکی کنده بر پای اوست"
